 8                 THE SECRETARY:   Resolution 1324, by 

 9    Senator Stec, memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul 

10    to proclaim January 25-31, 2026, as Medicolegal 

11    Death Investigation Professionals Week in the 

12    State of New York.

13                 ACTING PRESIDENT BAILEY:   Senator 

14    Stec on the resolution.

15                 SENATOR STEC:   Thank you, 

16    Mr. President.  

17                 And good morning, all my colleagues.  

18    Thank you for bringing this resolution before us 

19    today.  

20                 The role of the medicolegal death 

21    investigator is to investigate any death that 

22    falls under the jurisdiction of the medical 

23    examiner or coroner, including all suspicious, 

24    violent, unexplained and unexpected deaths.  

25                 The medicolegal death investigator 


                                                                244

 1    is responsible for the deceased person, whereas 

 2    the local law enforcement jurisdiction is 

 3    responsible for the scene.  The medicolegal death 

 4    investigator performs scene investigations 

 5    emphasizing information developed from the 

 6    decedent and determines the extent to which 

 7    further investigation is necessary.  

 8                 Medicolegal death investigators 

 9    should have a combination of education and skills 

10    encompassing areas of medicine and law.  

11                 And I'm thrilled today that we have 

12    a significant group of medicolegal death 

13    investigators from my district and from Senator 

14    Ashby's district and Senator Helming's district 

15    here with us today to memorialize this week, 

16    along with the Governor.  

17                 That would be Dr. Michael Sikirica, 

18    who is an M.D. and board-certified forensic 

19    pathologist; Dr. Kia Newman; Jay Heald; Chad 

20    Deans; Connie Goedert; Rob Lemieux; Sarah Coyne; 

21    Doug Pinzer; J. Eric Cullum; Sarah Holliday; and 

22    Robert Waltman.  

23                 So again, if you wouldn't mind, 

24    please extend the cordialities of the house to 

25    this group and thank them and all their 


                                                                245

 1    colleagues around the state for doing the 

 2    important work that they do for the people that 

 3    pass away that are in their care.
